blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Council on Disability Affairs (NCDA) has condemned remarks made by the all-male podcast hosts of Machong Chismisan about Kris Aquino’s son, Josh Aquino, who is on the autism spectrum, saying that persons with disabilities should be treated with respect and should not be subjected to ridicule or mockery. In a now-deleted podcast episode, one of the five hosts, Tito P, mocked Josh by saying “walang kwenta” while laughing.
